## Terms & Conditions

#### Who is Eligible?

- Approved Nationalities: You must hold a passport from India, Egypt, Jordan, Pakistan, Mexico, Indonesia, or Bangladesh (as approved by the Saudi Ministry of Tourism).
- Excluded Destinations: Please note that travel to Makkah or Madinah is not permitted under this specific visa program.

#### Your Travel Package Requirements

- To qualify, you must purchase a travel package directly through the Almosafer platform that meets the following criteria:
- Your package must include both a confirmed flight and a confirmed hotel stay at a 4-star or higher.
- Your flight arrival and departure dates must perfectly match your hotel check-in and check-out dates.
- Your trip must be between 2 and 88 days long, and all bookings must be completed at least 2 days before your departure.
- A single package can include up to 9 adults and 5 minors.
- A single package can include up to 9 adults and 5 minors. Minors are exempt from the minimum requirements.
- Travellers under 18 cannot apply independently and must be linked to an adult sponsor in the same package. If the sponsor’s application is rejected, all linked dependents will automatically be rejected.

#### Minimum Spend Rules

- To meet government regulations, your eligible package bookings (flights, hotels, and activities on Almosafer) must meet specific spending thresholds. Note: Travellers under 18 do not count toward these minimums.
- First 2 Days: The minimum spend is SAR 4,000 per adult. This consists of SAR 3,597.79 for your travel bookings, plus SAR 402.21 in mandatory government visa, insurance, and processing fees.
- Extended Stays: For trips longer than 2 days, an additional minimum spend of SAR 1,000 per adult per day is required.

#### Applying for Your Visa

- You can submit your visa application only after your bookings are confirmed. You are responsible for accurately entering your Almosafer booking reference IDs into the application to trigger the spend calculations.
- Ensure all submitted information is complete and exactly matches your travel documents. Incorrect details can lead to rejection.
- Additional Information: Almosafer reserves the right to request extra supporting documents if required by the authorities.

#### Approvals, Changes, and Cancellations

- Submitting an application does not guarantee a visa. Approval, processing times, and final decisions rest entirely with the relevant Saudi government authorities.
- If you cancel or modify your Almosafer bookings after your visa is issued and the value of your package falls below the required minimum spend, authorities may immediately revoke or invalidate your visa.
- If your application is rejected or cancelled due to incorrect information, cancellations, or missed requirements, the government, insurance, and processing fees are subject to government regulations and may be non-refundable.
- Almosafer reserves the right to amend, suspend, or discontinue this service in accordance with regulatory requirements. Standard Almosafer visa, flight, hotel, and activity terms and conditions also apply.
- Your submission of the visa request constitutes your explicit agreement to our listed Terms and Conditions and the Privacy Policy [outlined here](https://tjwlcdn.com/cms/landing_pages/mot/Ministry_of_Tourism_Terms_and_Conditions.pdf)
